Yaar Hamari Baat Suno is a lively and popular song from the Bollywood movie Roti, released in 1974. The song features Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz, and it is sung by the iconic Kishore Kumar. The music for the film was composed by Laxmikant-Pyarelal, and the lyrics were written by Anand Bakshi.
